description: This file defines a final immutable class `SessionedResponseErrorOrAck` that implements the `SessionedJsonifiable` interface. The class encapsulates JSON data and headers, providing methods to retrieve the JSON object, headers, extra fields, and associated session, which is absent in this implementation.

classes.name: SessionedResponseErrorOrAck
classes.description: An immutable class implementing `SessionedJsonifiable`, representing a session-aware JSON-able object with headers, specifically for error or acknowledgment responses without signal enrichment support.

methods.name: retrieveExtraFields
methods.description: Returns a completed future with an empty JSON object, indicating no extra fields are added.

methods.name: getSession
methods.description: Returns an empty Optional, indicating no associated streaming session.
